messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - CedarTech (dedicated pool cedarpool-prod) high error rate and anomalous logs detected. Possible customer data exposure in traces. @emma (oncall) paged :rotating_light:

emma (oncall): I’m on it. seeing elevated 5xx from cedarpool-prod, traced to KV cache miss and stack traces containing long ids. starting triage. tagging @mira-eng and @rafael-sre.

mira-eng: joining, attaching initial query results. errors concentrated on shard-3, rate spike ~08:13 UTC.

rafael-sre: adding context — this tenant is in a private VPC with dedicated nodes. we do not stream raw request bodies to external buckets normally, but there are recent debug logs from a maintenance job that included request metadata.

emma (oncall): @anya-legal please confirm whether we should preserve raw logs for legal/forensics. CedarTech has a compliance hold request in the ticket but no formal legal hold yet.

anya-legal: Please preserve everything for now. We need a log-hold and chain-of-custody for any exports. If PII is present, we need justification and an approved redaction exception from CedarTech counsel. I can start the paperwork but need a list of exact artifacts and who will access them.

ryan-pager: CedarTech CSM already messaged support: customer is worried, asking for evidence of data handling. They explicitly requested we do not share raw logs externally without redaction.

emma (oncall): Ok. mitigation plan: 1) snapshot concerned logs to an internal hold bucket encrypted with customer-specific KMS; 2) create a secure access list (MFA-only, limited ttl) for legal and SRE analysts; 3) perform automated PII scan + redaction pass before any external sharing; 4) notify customer and await their counsel for any unredacted export. executing steps 1-2 now.

sre-runbook-bot: runbook applied: "tenant-isolation-and-log-preservation-v2". Steps: isolate pool, disable debug-log job, snapshot last 48h logs. ETA ~12m.

rafael-sre: running snapshot command now:
```bash
# internal tool - snapshots logs for hold
log-snapper snapshot --pool cedarpool-prod --window 48h --target s3://internal-legal-hold/cedartech/2003456789 --encrypt-kms alias/cedartech-kms --reason "incident P1"
```

ops: note - ensure bucket lifecycle is set to no-delete until legal clears. tagging retention team.

anya-legal: Confirmed. I need the manifest (list of files + checksums) and the access audit log. Also record who executed the snapshot. I will prepare a formal preservation notice to CedarTech.

mira-eng: Patching the service to stop stack traces being logged. Deploying quick rollback to strip trace bodies. small config change: set `log.stack_trace_mode=summary` and disable the maintenance debug job.

emma (oncall): Good. @rafael-sre please redact sensitive fields before any copy leaves the VPC. If we must share with legal, use the internal viewer that masks identifiers by default.

rafael-sre: Understood. PII scan in progress — using the automated scanner `pii-finder` with heuristics for emails, ssns, customer_id patterns. Sample command:
```bash
pii-finder scan --input s3://internal-legal-hold/cedartech/2003456789 --output /tmp/cedartech-pii-report.json --patterns customer_id,email,ssn
```

rafael-sre: Scan results (summary): 34 hits flagged: 22 customer_id, 8 email, 4 potential ssn-like patterns (low confidence). Marking files for redaction.

anya-legal: Do not redact anything yet. We need to preserve originals. Create redacted copies for sharing. All original files must remain immutable and in the hold bucket; record checksums.

emma (oncall): Acknowledged. Creating manifest and checksums now.

emma (oncall): Manifest created: 48 files, checksums generated, snapshot job run by `rafael-sre` at 08:25 UTC. Bucket policy updated to deny deletion except by legal-admin role.

ryan-pager: Customer update sent: "We've isolated the impacted pool, preserved logs in encrypted storage, and are coordinating with legal. We'll follow your counsel before any raw logs are shared." CedarTech replied: "Thank you, please keep us advised."

anya-legal: I’ve started the preservation notice draft. Next steps for SRE: provide the manifest + access audit. For Engineering: confirm the debug job that emitted PII is disabled and provide the config commit id.

mira-eng: Debug job disabled. Commit id `c3a7f2b4`. Rolling patch in prod to remove trace payloads done.

emma (oncall): Temporary access grant created for `anya-legal` and `cedartech-counsel@cedartech.com` with read-only, TTL 72h, MFA required. All accesses logged.

ops: Retention override applied: lifecycle rule frozen, deletion blocked. Legal has been granted exception tag.

anya-legal: Filing the formal hold and sending it to CedarTech counsel now. I'll attach the manifest and the audit. Please don't share any unredacted logs externally until we have written consent.

rafael-sre: For traceability, we also exported the service config and the exception workflow to the incident ticket: #INC-73821.

emma (oncall): Closing the immediate pager — error rate dropping after patch and isolations. Remaining action items: legal hold paperwork, redacted exports if requested, post-incident review to update logging defaults.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: P1 -> mitigated. responders: @emma (oncall), @mira-eng, @rafael-sre, @anya-legal.

anya-legal: Thanks team. I'll follow up with timeline and retention end date in 24h. If CedarTech requests raw logs for their internal counsel, we will route through a secure transfer with documented consent.

emma (oncall): Great work. tagging #postmortems to schedule review. :thumbsup:
